certificates.description:
A set of Certificates defines for the given hostname.
There can be defined up to fifteen certificates in each Certificate Map Entry.
Each certificate must match pattern projects/*/locations/*/certificates/*.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: A human-readable description of the resource.

hostname.description:
A Hostname (FQDN, e.g. example.com) or a wildcard hostname expression (*.example.com)
for a set of hostnames with common suffix. Used as Server Name Indication (SNI) for
selecting a proper certificate.
hostname.rationale: An FQDN or wildcard hostname used as the SNI key to select a certificate in the map entry. This is a team-owned identifier; a platform policy cannot constrain it to 'approved domains' without hardcoding specific names we cannot know, so it is overreaching rather than a structural control.

labels.description:
Set of labels associated with a Certificate Map Entry.
An object containing a list of "key": value pairs.
Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Free-form key/value metadata tags on the resource. Labels are cosmetic/organisational and do not control access, encryption, or exposure; governance tagging is a team convention, not a structural security control.

map.description: A map entry that is inputted into the certificate map

matcher.description: A predefined matcher for particular cases, other than SNI selection
matcher.rationale: Selects a predefined matcher (e.g. a primary/fallback entry) for certificate selection instead of SNI hostname matching. This is a functional routing choice for how a certificate map entry is matched; it does not weaken or strengthen access, encryption, or exposure, so it maps to no security archetype.

name.description:
A user-defined name of the Certificate Map Entry. Certificate Map Entry
names must be unique globally and match pattern
'projects/*/locations/*/certificateMaps/*/certificateMapEntries/*'

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
